definitions.explanation: A pleasant, gentle warmth. Can refer to physical warmth or the figurative warmth of human kindness and affection.

examples.japanese: {手|て}の{温|ぬく}もりを{感|かん}じた。
examples.english: I felt the warmth of a hand.

examples.japanese: {木|き}の{家|いえ}には{温|ぬく}もりがある。
examples.english: A wooden house has a feeling of warmth.

examples.japanese: {家族|かぞく}の{温|ぬく}もりに{包|つつ}まれて{育|そだ}った。
examples.english: I grew up wrapped in the warmth of my family.

notes:
{温|ぬく}もり conveys a gentle, comforting warmth — both physical and emotional. It is often used in sentimental or poetic contexts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {温|ぬく}もりを{感|かん}じる (to feel warmth)
- {温|ぬく}もりに{包|つつ}まれる (to be enveloped in warmth)
- {温|ぬく}もりのある〜 (~ with warmth, warm and inviting ~)
- {人|ひと}の{温|ぬく}もり (human warmth)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {暖|あたた}かさ: warmth (more neutral, also used for temperature)
- {温|ぬく}もり: warmth (more emotional, intimate, poetic)
